title: allophylus ternatus
intro: Allophylus ternatus, commonly known as the African Pear, is a plant species that belongs to the Sapindaceae family. This plant is traditionally used in African and Asian folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its reported health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Allophylus ternatus include its ability to act as an analgesic and antipyretic, making it a valuable remedy for pain relief and fever reduction. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
